null_H_means: infinity (equal weights); execute original OLS as control after mathematical equality gate
weights: 2**(-(63-i)/H), i=0..63; latest weight1; no threshold or normalization
numerics: weighted centered x and weighted centered y; subtract first y before centering; per-window sum; strict sign, no epsilon threshold
real_flip_matching: OLS chronological reversal Voronoi cells bounded by midpoints between adjacent OLS reversals of either direction; outer cells bounded by performance-used signal interval; within each cell choose nearest same-destination EWLS reversal, tie earlier; one-to-one; unmatched EWLS=added, unmatched OLS=cancelled under this descriptive convention
trade_matching: also report exact entry-time/direction identity; unmatched exact entries include shifted trades and are NOT called cancelled
winner_attribution: fixed original OLS top10 closed net trades; actual position overlapping original entry; first same-direction exit in interval; actual MTM PnL across entire original interval incl reversals, entry/exit fees pro-rated only by actual overlap events, endpoint original exit-open marked raw; all directions separately

synthetic.noise: fixed shared Gaussian log-price observation noise across models and directions with the same seed; noise only after reversal for trend cases
synthetic.truth_for_trend_cases: latent increment sign changes at bar192; first new-direction slope at/after192 gives nonnegative delay; wrong flips=destination disagrees with latent increment sign at that bar; post-response switchbacks separately counted
synthetic.truth_for_shock_cases: no single persistent trend reversal; first change vs pre-shock signal is descriptive; additional flips vs paired unshocked path NOT labelled false by fiat
